sentence: During the quarter we incurred $18 million in additional expenses and lost revenues combined because of Hurricanes Helene and Milton.

expect.metric: additional expenses and lost revenues combined

sentence: After Hurricane Ian, we expect an adverse sales impact of $7 million in the coming quarter.
We now estimate that Hurricane Ian reduced our sales by $9 million in the quarter that ended last month.
Following Hurricane Sally, our policy provided coverage of up to $35 million, and we received $4 million in insurance recoveries during the quarter.
Following Hurricane Ida, we expect to receive $6 million in insurance recoveries next quarter.
We recorded $11 million in net pre-tax charges related to Hurricane Ian, equivalent to an after-tax earnings impact of $0.08 per share.
After Hurricane Helene, our supplier estimated its own lost sales at $8 million, while the effect on our sales remained unknown.
Our sales fell by $12 million as a result of Hurricane Milton and an unrelated product recall, and we could not allocate that total between the two causes.
In the quarter when Hurricane Laura temporarily closed our warehouse, we repaid $20 million of debt according to our existing payment schedule.
